Neugebauer, co-founder and largest shareholder of Fermi Inc., disclosed that the company has dropped its lawsuit against him, which was filed to validate a 70% supermajority bylaw amendment, after a Texas Business Court ordered the company to produce documents and testimony explaining the rationale for the bylaw.
